mechanism: Replace Rose-curve angle θ with market q=k*(Close−MA)/ATR; FVI_x=sin(n·q/(2d))·cos(q) or FVI_y=sin(n·q/(2d))·sin(q), bounded in [−1,+1]. ATR in the denominator makes the oscillator less sensitive in high vol and more sensitive in low vol.
data_needed: Close, MA(period), ATR(period), params n,d,k; choose X or Y component.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any _Symbol/_Period; MA/ATR periods and n,d,k user-tunable; demo EA uses AO filter on chart TF.
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a volatility-normalized geometric oscillator (Rose/FVI) whose period T=4πd/n is tunable for major vs reactive cycles—distinct from ATR alone or RSI.
quote: Throughout these changes, the FVI remains entirely volatility-normalized through its dependence on ATR. This ensures that the oscillator adapts automatically to changing market regimes—expanding in quiet markets and compressing in volatile ones

mechanism: Regime/exhaustion sensor: AO>0 (uptrend) and FVI crosses below −0.7 → buy exhaustion in bull trend; AO<0 and FVI crosses above +0.7 → sell exhaustion in bear trend. Sustained FVI>0 / <0 as bullish/bearish momentum bias; optional X/Y asymmetry as persistent one-sided bias.
data_needed: FVI series (prev+cur), Awesome Oscillator buffer, MinBars between entries.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any _Symbol/_Period; AO and FVI on chart TF; cooldown e.g. 10 bars.
why_new_for_mis: Combines ATR-normalized FVI extremes with AO trend polarity as a sided exhaustion/regime sensor for MIS entries.
quote: A buy trade is opened when: AO > 0 (uptrend), and FVI crosses below −0.7 (strong downward exhaustion within a bullish trend)

mechanism: Label trades from oscillators only (no future prices): RSI/CCI/Stoch/BB/Fourier oversold→Buy(0), overbought→Sell(1), neutral→Hold(2). Train classifiers on same-series features (close−MA diffs, multi-period RSI). Prefer ranging instruments; oscillators stick in extremes in trends. Optional profit-check labeler reintroduces look-ahead.
data_needed: OHLC series; oscillator periods and OB/OS levels; feature periods e.g. 5..45 step 5; AUDCAD H1 example 2015–2021 split.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: AUDCAD_H1 primary; ranging FX emphasized; forward 2018–2025 after 2015–2017 train.
why_new_for_mis: MIS neural/sequence labeling scheme that avoids look-ahead bias by using causal oscillator thresholds—more robust OOS than future-return labels.
quote: Since oscillators generate buy and sell signals without look-ahead, machine learning algorithms are not exposed to labeling bias and remain effective over the entire historical range

mechanism: Differential Search Algorithm: population migration with B/S/E1/E2 direction strategies, Gamma scale factor, mutation maps, greedy selection—benchmarked on Hilly/Forest/Megacity test functions only.
why_new_for_mis: No market regime/vol/liquidity/neural sensing; pure EA-parameter optimizer.
quote: DSA simulates the migration of a superorganism (a flock or swarm) in search of better conditions

mechanism: Send last N OHLCV bars (CSV) to an LLM via API; prompt forces S/R from local max/min (~50 bars), Price Action patterns on levels, multi-step ACTION BUY/SELL/HOLD + SL/TP/REASON. Suggested upgrades: multi-TF (H1/H4/D1 structure + LTF patterns), open-position context, post-candle-close timing.
data_needed: MT5 copy_rates OHLCV (e.g. 100 bars M5); OpenRouter API; regex parse ACTION/ENTRY/SL/TP/REASON.

quote: When the model receives a set of OHLCV data, it instantly understands the overall structure of price movement, identifies where key support and resistance levels are forming, recognizes candlestick patterns, determines the trend’s direction

mechanism: dDCA adapted from immune Danger/Safe signals to continuous optimization: D/S from population fitness normalization, k-context accumulation, Mature=local mutation / Semi-mature=reinit or move-to-best. Tested only on AO benchmarks.

quote: The article proposes an adaptation of the Deterministic Dendritic Cell Algorithm for continuous optimization problems

mechanism: Bound tick volume: t=m*(Vol−AvgVol)/StdVol or t=m*log(Vol); then Butterfly f(t)=sin(t)·(e^cos(t)−2cos(4t)−sin(t/12)^5) → ~[−3,3] or TripleSine (sin(t))^3 → [−1,1]. Threshold crossings (+/−) with candle direction for liquidity-activity signals; alternating +/- thresholds for second entries.
data_needed: tick_volume[]; VolumePeriod (e.g. 20); AvgVol/StdVol; ScaleFactor m; InputMethod; SmoothingMethod.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any chart TF using tick volume (FX proxy); real volume noted for stocks.

Confirm with tick-volume ≥ VolumeThreshold×avg(lookback) and post-purge window ≤ MaxCandlesPostPurge. Prefer HTF trend narrative (9/21 SMA stack on W1/D1; 50-SMA filter on trade TF).

Only take post-purge continuation with trend; treat post-major-liquidity MSS as regime-change entries.

mechanism: On regime TF (default H4): ATR=σ̂_t; μ̂_t=(1/N)Σ|MA[i]−MA[i+1]| (absolute bar-by-bar MA change, not net displacement); ratio σ/μ high→ranging (safe for BGT), low→trending (dangerous). Gate re-arming when ratio < MinSigmaMuRatio with cooldown of N favorable bars. Four states: ranging±vol vs trending±vol; quiet trend is worst.
data_needed: H4 ATR handle; MA handle over lookback; InpMinSigmaMuRatio (e.g. 5); cooldown bars.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: FX-style grid EA; spacing ATR on D1, regime ATR/drift on H4; cycle hours default 72.
why_new_for_mis: Principled ranging-vs-trending regime sensor from σ/μ with absolute-drift proxy—directly usable as MIS grid/strategy gate.
quote: High ratio means volatility dominates drift, safe for bi-directional grid trading. Low ratio means drift dominates, dangerous

mechanism: Frozen-baseline CUSUM CPD: collect baseline window, freeze it, accumulate deviations; when CUSUM crosses scaled threshold declare structural break → block new BGT or force TGT mode. Clears only after VolatilityGate full recovery cooldown. Complements continuous σ/μ with discrete regime-change event.
data_needed: Baseline window of regime features; CUSUM threshold; g_cpdBlockActive flag; TGT enable switch.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same grid EA; regime TF H4; cycle-start mode selection BGT/TGT/MGT.
why_new_for_mis: Explicit structural-break change sensor (CUSUM on frozen baseline) for MIS regime-shift events, not just smoothed vol/drift.
quote: The baseline is intentionally frozen after initialization, not recomputed on a rolling basis. A rolling baseline would adapt toward the very trend it is supposed to detect

mechanism: Normalize price to SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE; DoubleToString(price,_Digits); strip decimal; count trailing zeros = ZeroSize strength. Filter by minZero scaled to TF (scalp≥2, intraday≥3, swing≥4). Major levels as institutional liquidity magnets; trade with oscillator confluence and buffer beyond the level.
data_needed: Tick size, _Digits, visible price range; InpMinZeroCount; optional RSI/Stoch for fade.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: AUDUSD/GBPUSD MN1; BTCUSD W1; XAUUSD W1/M1; JPY 3-digit and 5-digit FX; crypto/indices handled by string parse.
why_new_for_mis: Deterministic, float-safe psychological-level liquidity strength metric (ZeroSize) MIS can rank S/R magnets across Digits/TickSize.
quote: We introduce the ZeroSize metric as a numeric measure of level strength. We also describe a deterministic detection pipeline (tick-size normalization plus string-suffix analysis)
